# Architecture Decisions

## [TEAMLEAD] [t1] — 2026-09-30

**Decision**: Ratify constitution v1.0.0 with active root and production behavior authoritative, archive immutable until parity PASS, fixed target versions, executable parity evidence, and prohibited deployment/Git/archive-removal operations.
**Rationale**: These constraints preserve current behavior and data while defining a deterministic, evidence-based modernization boundary.

## [ARCHITECT] [t2.1] — 2026-09-30

**Decision**: Use additive publication statuses, server-enforced Cognito auth, fail-closed governance, ordered Express middleware, explicit persistence adapters, atomic ingestion, and computed light-theme fidelity.
**Rationale**: These decisions close the seven architecture blockers while preserving API, data, authorization, ingestion, and visual behavior.

## [ARCHITECT] [t2] — 2026-09-30

**Decision**: Accept the remediated architecture analysis with ADR-01 through ADR-07 embedded in the primary contracts and retain the 23-unit boundary.
**Rationale**: The fresh architecture gate found no unresolved HIGH or CRITICAL findings.

## [ARCHITECT] [t4] — 2026-09-30

**Decision**: Implement parity as one self-contained sibling TypeScript runtime with 14 lazy browser paths, 15 preserved HTTP method/path contracts, deterministic clinical ownership, server-enforced Cognito authorization, and one explicitly selected persistence adapter.
**Rationale**: This preserves all authoritative active-root behavior and additive archived capabilities without runtime coupling to or removal of either parity source.

## [TEAMLEAD] [t9.4] - 2026-09-30

**Decision**: Amend the destination to the active workspace root while retaining the single-runtime module boundaries, frozen pre-change behavior as the no-regression baseline, and byte-immutable archive provenance.
**Rationale**: The explicit current user instruction supersedes the earlier sibling-directory default; active-root execution would otherwise conflict with VG-00 and the implementation task paths.
